summary: Wave 1: glass-box recall failure-analysis + zero-shot lexical lever sweep across 5 BEIR corpora, synthesized into a per-corpus tuning map

tuning_map.profile: DROWNED-dominant: drowned 9.7% vs gap 2.0% (4.9x). High BM25 floor 0.8759, median drown rank 276. Lexical-fixable.
tuning_map.recommended_lever: dfcap10 (df-cap family): bm25 0.8759 -> 0.8816 (+0.0057, the largest dfcap10 win of any corpus). dfcap30 also helps (+0.0033). Avoid 2way (-0.0073), idf2 (-0.0037), and especially anchor (-0.3195).

tuning_map.profile: SEMANTIC-BOUND: gap 19.8% vs drowned 2.5% (7.9x, the highest gap-share). Low BM25 floor 0.2379, median drown rank 292. Lexical levers near-useless.
tuning_map.recommended_lever: distilled-SPLADE / semantic expansion. Best lexical lever dfcap10 yields only +0.0027 (to 0.2406); the 19.8% gold-with-no-shared-word fraction is unreachable by any lexical lever. dfcap30 is the safe no-op fallback (+0.0003). anchor -0.0813.

tuning_map.profile: DROWNED but LEVER-RESISTANT (surprising): drowned 27% (highest) vs gap 2.6%, yet no intersection lever helps. Median drown rank 638. BM25 0.5078.
tuning_map.recommended_lever: Keep BM25 (best_lever=bm25, gain 0). Only dfcap30 ties (0.5078); every aggressive lever hurts: 2way -0.0446, 3way -0.0562, dfcap10 -0.0125, idf2 -0.0138, anchor -0.1897. High drowned% should be lexically fixable but isn't -> the drowning here is by query-relevant common terms, so intersection/df-cap discards signal. Needs reranking or SPLADE term-weighting, not hard lexical pruning.

tuning_map.profile: SEMANTIC-BOUND de facto / DIAGNOSTIC-UNCLASSIFIED: reports drowned 0 / gap 0 but BM25 recall is only 0.0949 (~90% of gold unretrieved). The 0/0 split is uninformative — the diagnostic failed to classify the misses.
tuning_map.recommended_lever: Keep BM25 (best_lever=bm25, gain 0) then add distilled-SPLADE for the unrecovered 90%. Every lever HURTS: dfcap10 -0.0155 (worst), dfcap30 -0.0073, 3way -0.0142, 2way -0.0092, anchor -0.0075. Long descriptive queries -> treat as semantic-bound.

tuning_map.profile: INTERSECTION-FAVORABLE (the outlier): drowned 0 / gap 0 reported, BM25 0.5579. The only corpus where multi-term intersection helps.
tuning_map.recommended_lever: 2way (intersection family): bm25 0.5579 -> 0.5653 (+0.0073), the only corpus where 2way wins and the best lever overall. 3way roughly neutral (-0.0024). df-cap mildly hurts (dfcap30 -0.0054, dfcap10 -0.0084); idf2 -0.0118; anchor -0.0805. Argument/debate queries reward co-occurrence.

general_patterns: ANCHOR IS UNIVERSALLY TOXIC: negative on 5/5 corpora, mean -0.1357, worst -0.3195 (scifact 0.8759->0.5564, a 36% relative recall collapse) and -0.1897 (fiqa). Never deploy anchor on any corpus tested.
IDF^2 NEVER HELPS: negative on 5/5, mean -0.0065, worst -0.0138 (fiqa). Over-weighting rare terms consistently drops recall; drop idf2 from the lever set entirely.

INTERSECTION LEVERS (2way/3way) ARE MOSTLY HARMFUL: 2way mean -0.0110 (helps only touche +0.0074), 3way mean -0.0154 (helps nobody meaningfully, max +0.0002 nfcorpus, worst -0.0562 fiqa). Hard term-intersection discards gold that matches on a subset of query terms. Use only on co-occurrence-friendly corpora (touche).

DF-CAP IS THE GENTLEST FAMILY: dfcap30 mean -0.0018 with worst-case only -0.0073 (the smallest downside of any lever), positive on scifact+nfcorpus and a tie on fiqa. dfcap10 is more aggressive: mean -0.0056, helps the two SMALL drowned corpora (scifact +0.0057, nfcorpus +0.0027) but hurts the LARGE ones (trec -0.0155, fiqa -0.0125, touche -0.0084).

DROWNED% DOES NOT RELIABLY PREDICT LEVER BENEFIT: fiqa has the highest drowned fraction (27%) yet zero lever helps, while scifact (9.7% drowned) gets the biggest dfcap10 win. The mechanism of drowning (common noise terms vs query-relevant common terms) matters more than the raw drowned%.

LEVER MAGNITUDES ARE TINY ON HARD CORPORA: best lexical gains are all <=+0.0073 absolute. Lexical tuning is a marginal lever; the large recall deficits (nfcorpus 0.24, trec 0.09) are gap-driven and require semantic expansion, not lexical retuning.
synthesis.universal_default: dfcap30 (moderate document-frequency cap). It is the only lever that is never catastrophically negative (worst case -0.0073 on trec-covid), is positive on scifact (+0.0033) and nfcorpus (+0.0003), and ties BM25 exactly on fiqa (0.5078). Mean delta -0.0018, the closest-to-neutral of all levers while retaining upside. Where you want strictly zero downside, fall back to plain BM25 (the measured best_lever for fiqa and trec-covid); reserve the more aggressive dfcap10 for small drowned-dominant corpora (scifact, nfcorpus) only.
synthesis.notes:
Quantitative basis (all deltas vs BM25, computed from the provided lever_recalls): scifact dfcap10 +0.0057 / 2way -0.0073 / anchor -0.3195; nfcorpus dfcap10 +0.0027 / anchor -0.0813; fiqa dfcap30 0.0000 / 2way -0.0446 / 3way -0.0562 / anchor -0.1897; trec-covid all negative, dfcap10 -0.0155 worst; touche 2way +0.0073 (only positive 2way). Per-lever mean delta: anchor -0.1357, 3way -0.0154, 2way -0.0110, idf2 -0.0065, dfcap10 -0.0056, dfcap30 -0.0018. anchor/idf2 negative on 5/5 corpora.

SEMANTIC-BOUND classification: nfcorpus is the clean case (gap 19.8% >> drowned 2.5%, best lexical gain only +0.0027) -> MUST use distilled-SPLADE. trec-covid is semantic-bound de facto: its diagnostic reports drowned=0/gap=0 but BM25 recall is 0.0949, meaning ~90% of gold is unretrieved and UNCLASSIFIED by the diagnostic -> the 0/0 split is a diagnostic gap, not a clean corpus; treat as semantic-bound and add SPLADE.

FLAGGED INCONSISTENCIES / SURPRISES: (1) fiqa paradox -- highest drowned fraction (27%) of any corpus, yet every lexical lever ties-or-hurts and best_lever=bm25 (gain 0). High drowned% would predict df-cap/intersection wins; it doesn't, because the drowning terms are query-relevant common words that intersection/df-cap discard. fiqa needs term-WEIGHTING (SPLADE) or reranking, not lexical PRUNING -- so it behaves semantic-leaning despite a tiny gap fraction (2.6%). (2) trec-covid drowned=0/gap=0 vs 0.0949 recall is internally inconsistent (the classifier covered ~0 of the misses). (3) median_drown_rank for the two large drowned corpora sits near the cutoff (fiqa 638, scifact 276, nfcorpus 292), suggesting many drowned golds are just past the retrieval depth -- increasing candidate pool depth (recall@k) may recover more than any lever, consistent with the repo's standing 'recall is the lever, pool-limited' finding. (4) Only webis-touche2020 rewards intersection (2way +0.0073); it is the lone intersection-favorable corpus and should not generalize the 2way lever to others.

LEVER FAMILY SUMMARY: deploy dfcap30 as universal default; dfcap10 only on small drowned corpora (scifact/nfcorpus); 2way only on touche; BM25-only on fiqa/trec-covid; SPLADE on nfcorpus + trec-covid (and as the real accuracy lever for fiqa). Never deploy anchor or idf2 anywhere.
